shared_or_similar_visual_information: A vertical line segment joining the x-axis to the upper edge of a shaded region. On the left, use the vertical edge of the gray triangle directly below N. On the right, use the vertical divider at x = 1 at the left edge of the shaded region labeled area = ∞.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: This edge delimits the shaded region at the x-coordinate of N. Right image: This divider sets the horizontal starting location of the selected region.
Rationales: The x-coordinate of the vertical edge sets one horizontal limit of the shaded area in both figures. A similar-looking shaded region extending past that edge would have a different area.
